metadata.question: Between January 8 and January 15, 2020, did Sistan-Baluchestan experience over 3 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Sistan-Baluchestan province, Iran - Date range: January 8-15, 2020 (8 days) - Collection: GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) or CHIRPS for rainfall data - GPM provides daily precipitation at ~11km resolution 2. Masking strategy: - No masking needed for precipitation data (it's already quality-controlled) - Need to sum precipitation over the 8-day period 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Precipitation = 0-3 inches (answer B) or >3 inches (answer A) - C1: No images in collection for this period - C2: After processing, no valid pixels (unlikely for GPM/CHIRPS as they have global coverage) - C3: Result is None/NaN or invalid (e.g., negative precipitation or extremely high values like >1000mm in 8 days) 4. Units: Need to convert from mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4mm, so 3 inches = 76.2mm) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const sistanBaluchestan = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([58.0, 25.0, 63.5, 31.5]); // Approximate bounds const startDate = '2020-01-08'; const endDate = '2020-01-16'; // Exclusive end date // 2. Data Acquisition - GPM daily precipitation let precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(sistanBaluchestan) .select('precipitationCal'); // Calibrated precipitation in mm/hr const colSize = precipCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`GPM Images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("No GPM data available for the period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum precipitation over the period // GPM provides mm/hr in 30-minute intervals, so we need to multiply by 0.5 hours const totalPrecip = precipCol.map(function(img) { return img.multiply(0.5); // Convert mm/hr to mm per 30-min interval }).sum(); // 4. Calculate mean precipitation over the region const stats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: sistanBaluchestan, scale: 11000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const precipMean = stats.get('precipitationCal_mean').getInfo(); const pixelCount = stats.get('precipitationCal_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (precipMean === null || precipMean === undefined || isNaN(precipMean)) { console.log("Calculation returned invalid result."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Check for unrealistic values if (precipMean < 0 || precipMean > 1000) { console.log(`Invalid precipitation value: ${precipMean} mm`); console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Convert mm to inches and compare const precipInches = precipMean / 25.4; const threshold = 3.0; console.log(`Total precipitation: ${precipMean.toFixed(2)} mm (${precipInches.toFixed(2)} inches)`); console.log(`Threshold: ${threshold} inches (${(threshold * 25.4).toFixed(2)} mm)`); if (precipInches > threshold) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
